message.content:
An editorial illustration serves as the cover for "TEMPO" magazine. The white masthead sits atop an orange-toned sky filled with stylized grey and orange clouds. Below the masthead, two burning electrical transformers on a utility pole emit thick black and grey smoke. A man in a dark suit and red tie stands in the foreground, his hands held near his chest with index fingers touching. Behind him, a dense landscape of small, angled wooden houses and numerous thin utility poles with tangled wires stretches towards the horizon. 

The main headline, "TERSENGAT SETRUM PLN," appears in large white capital letters across the center. Below it, a smaller block of white text reads: "KOMISI PEMBERANTASAN KORUPSI MENELISIK PERAN DIREKTUR UTAMA PERUSAHAAN LISTRIK NEGARA DALAM PERKARA SUAP PEMBANGKIT LISTRIK. TAK BERHENTI PADA SOFYAN BASIR." Additional text includes "LOMPAT PAGAR CALON LEGISLATOR" and "FREEPORT: SORAK-SORAI SEBELUM KERJA USAI" at the top, and "23-29 JULI 2018," a barcode, and pricing information in the bottom right corner.
